summary: This directory serves as the root domain layer for the application, organizing core business logic and data definitions into distinct functional modules. It acts as a centralized repository for managing entity identification, data schemas, and domain-specific operations for the system.
responsibilities: Manage domain-specific business logic for core entities
Define and export shared data schemas
Provision unique identifiers for system entities
Provide centralized interfaces for modular domain access
relationships: Domain modules utilize shared schema definitions to ensure data consistency across operations.
Identifier generation logic relies on domain-specific structures to create unique entity references.
Centralized export interfaces allow external consumers to interact with domain functionality without deep dependency paths.
designDecisions: Modular domain separation for administrative, customer, and order contexts
Centralized export strategy for simplified module consumption
Logical isolation of identifier generation from data schema definitions
Namespace-based organization to enforce domain boundaries
